comment.en: The main driver is fog/low cloud: the US model shows visibility of 76-135 m in several daytime periods from 10/26 to 10/30, e.g. 76 m on 10/26 14:00-20:00 and 135 m on 10/27 08:00-14:00. However, only this one model provides visibility, and there is no airport forecast (TAF) or airport observation (METAR) to check against. Everything else is low: the highest gust is only 17.7 kt from the German model, the chance of gusts over 29 kt is 0% throughout, and the most rain is 7.3 mm in 6 hours. Overall: Medium.

The US model forecasts visibility of only 76 to 135 m during 10/26 08:00–10/27 02:00, 10/27 08:00–10/28 02:00, 10/28 08:00–10/29 02:00, 10/29 08:00–20:00, and 10/30 14:00–10/31 02:00. Low visibility from a single model is not convincing, and the chance of gusts over 49 kt is 0%.

comment.zh-TW: 主因是強風。10/27 08 時至 10/28 02 時三格，六個模式中三到四個認為中，美國 AI 模式估算陣風最高 45.1 節，歐洲模式陣風 38.1 節；但陣風超過 49 節的機率一直是 0%，側風最大 13.9 節，未達門檻。機場預報（TAF）10/27 凌晨平均風 22 節、陣風 32 節，目前有陸上強風特報。整體停飛風險為中，10/28 白天起轉低。
comment.zh-HK: 主因是強風。10/27 08 時至 10/28 02 時三格，六個模式中三至四個認為中，美國 AI 模式估算陣風最高 45.1 節，歐洲模式陣風 38.1 節；但陣風超過 49 節的機率一直是 0%，側風最大 13.9 節，未達門檻。機場預報（TAF）10/27 凌晨平均風 22 節、陣風 32 節，目前有陸上強風特報。整體停飛風險為中，10/28 日間起轉低。
comment.zh-CN: 主因是强风。10/27 08 时至 10/28 02 时三个时段，六个模式中三到四个认为中，美国 AI 模式估算阵风最高 45.1 节，欧洲模式阵风 38.1 节；但阵风超过 49 节的概率一直是 0%，侧风最大 13.9 节，未达门槛。机场预报（TAF）10/27 凌晨平均风 22 节、阵风 32 节，目前有陆上强风特报。整体停飞风险为中，10/28 白天起转低。
comment.en: Strong wind is the main cause. Across the three periods from 10/27 08 h to 10/28 02 h local, three to four of six models say Medium; the US AI model's estimated gust peaks at 45.1 kt and the European model's gusts reach 38.1 kt. However, the chance of gusts over 49 kt stays at 0%, and crosswind peaks at 13.9 kt, below the threshold. The airport forecast (TAF) gives a 22 kt mean wind with 32 kt gusts early on 10/27, and a land strong wind advisory is in effect. Overall disruption risk is Medium, easing to Low from the daytime of 10/28.

comment.zh-TW: 未來五天澎湖機場的停飛風險為中，主因是強風／側風。10/27 08–14 時至 10/27 20 時–10/28 02 時風力最強，陣風超過 29 節的機率達 100%。其中 10/27 14–20 時與 10/27 20 時–10/28 02 時，6 個模式中 4 個認為中以上，歐洲模式陣風達 37.4 至 38.1 節，美國 AI 模式估算陣風達 45.1 節。10/28 02–08 時起風力減弱，停飛風險轉為低。
comment.zh-HK: 未來五天澎湖機場的停飛風險為中，主因是強風／側風。10/27 08–14 時至 10/27 20 時–10/28 02 時風力最強，陣風超過 29 節的機率達 100%。其中 10/27 14–20 時與 10/27 20 時–10/28 02 時，6 個模式中 4 個認為中以上，歐洲模式陣風達 37.4 至 38.1 節，美國 AI 模式估算陣風達 45.1 節。10/28 02–08 時起風力減弱，停飛風險轉為低。
comment.zh-CN: 未来五天澎湖机场的停飞风险为中，主因是强风／侧风。10/27 08–14 时至 10/27 20 时–10/28 02 时风力最强，阵风超过 29 节的概率达 100%。其中 10/27 14–20 时与 10/27 20 时–10/28 02 时，6 个模式中 4 个认为中以上，欧洲模式阵风达 37.4 至 38.1 节，美国 AI 模式估算阵风达 45.1 节。10/28 02–08 时起风力减弱，停飞风险转为低。
comment.en: The disruption risk at Penghu Airport over the next five days is Medium, mainly due to strong winds and crosswind. Winds are strongest from 10/27 08:00–14:00 to 10/27 20:00–10/28 02:00, with a 100% chance of gusts over 29 kt. During 10/27 14:00–20:00 and 10/27 20:00–10/28 02:00, 4 of 6 models say Medium or above, with European model gusts reaching 37.4 to 38.1 kt and US AI model estimated gusts reaching 45.1 kt. From 10/28 02:00–08:00 onward, winds weaken and the disruption risk drops to Low.

In other periods, such as 10/27 09:00–15:00, the German model peaks at 31.9 kt gusts, the European ensemble shows a 19% chance of gusts over 29 kt, and the airport forecast (TAF) has a mean wind of just 10 kt, with all models rating wind and rain as Low.
